description: A shell script for building, testing, or onboarding a Docker-based environment for OpenClaw, including functions to run various onboarding scenarios and validate configurations.

methods.name: start_gateway
methods.description: Starts the OpenClaw gateway process on a specified port.

methods.name: wait_for_gateway
methods.description: Waits for the gateway to be listening on the specified port.

methods.name: stop_gateway
methods.description: Stops the running gateway process.

methods.name: run_wizard_cmd
methods.description: Executes a wizard command with input handling, logging, and optional gateway management.

methods.name: run_wizard
methods.description: Runs an onboarding wizard with preset flags.

methods.name: make_home
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory for onboarding scenarios.

methods.name: set_isolated_openclaw_env
methods.description: Sets environment variables for an isolated OpenClaw environment.

methods.name: assert_file
methods.description: Checks if a file exists and exits if missing.

methods.name: assert_dir
methods.description: Checks if a directory exists and exits if missing.

methods.name: select_skip_hooks
methods.description: Automates selecting 'Skip for now' in wizard hooks.

methods.name: send_local_basic
methods.description: Simulates user interaction for local onboarding with minimal prompts.

methods.name: send_reset_config_only
methods.description: Performs a configured reset flow for onboarding.

methods.name: send_channels_flow
methods.description: Automates configuring channels in the wizard.

methods.name: send_skills_flow
methods.description: Automates configuring skills in the wizard.

methods.name: run_case_local_basic
methods.description: Runs a test case for local onboarding and validates the generated config.

methods.name: run_case_remote_non_interactive
methods.description: Runs a non-interactive remote onboarding scenario.

methods.name: run_case_reset
methods.description: Runs an onboarding scenario that resets configuration.

methods.name: run_case_channels
methods.description: Runs the channels configuration wizard flow.

methods.name: run_case_skills
methods.description: Runs the skills configuration wizard flow.

methods.name: assert_log_not_contains
methods.description: Checks the log file does not contain a specific string.

methods.name: validate_local_basic_log
methods.description: Validates that certain unwanted strings are absent from logs.
